props.text: Who to ask for at Sun State.

items.q: Who is the CEO of Sun State International Trucks?
items.a: Oscar Horton is CEO. Miriam Horton is VP and Anthony Martell is COO.

items.q: Who do I contact about buying a trailer?
items.a: Scott Anderson is Truck & Trailer Sales Manager and Debbie Hall handles New Truck and Globe Trailer sales. Sun State Trailers sells Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers from the Tampa and Davenport locations.

items.q: Who manages parts and service at each location?
items.a: Jason Velez in Tampa, Paul Royals in Davenport, Mike Velez in Sarasota, Ronnie Jones in Brooksville and Damian Groene at the Tampa Aftermarket center.

items.q: Where is the Sun State team located?
items.a: Six Florida locations: Tampa (6020 E Adamo Dr), Sarasota (1000 Sarasota Center Blvd), Davenport (41609 Hwy 27), Brooksville (17127 Runway Drive), Tampa Aftermarket Parts (7105 E 6th Ave) and Trailer Sales in Tampa.

values.heading: Ready to get on the road?
